llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent for Rosette Text Analytics, but its setup instructions include unverified remote installer commands that can execute changing external code on the user's machine.

dimensions.detail: Normal operation is limited to Bash commands matching oo *, which is proportionate for an oo CLI connector skill; the installer path is the disproportionate part because it can run arbitrary local code if invoked.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup recommends piping installer scripts from cli.oomol.com directly into bash or PowerShell without pinning, checksum, signature verification, or review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad for any Rosette Text Analytics request, but the runtime instructions stay focused on the OOMOL connector and tell the agent to inspect schemas before running actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not include bundled persistence code, but setup asks users to install a CLI and sign in/connect an account, which creates ongoing local account/tool state expected for this integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to run Rosette Text Analytics actions through the OOMOL oo CLI, and the listed connector actions are text-analysis reads such as sentiment, entity extraction, categories, language, and tokens.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this skill only if you trust OOMOL and the Rosette connector path. Before installing the oo CLI, prefer official verified package or release instructions, avoid piping remote scripts directly into a shell, and review or verify any installer before running it.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: Installing the oo CLI is related to the skill, but direct curl-to-shell and PowerShell iex installation is higher risk than necessary and lacks integrity verification.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad Rosette trigger is visible in the description and aligns with the connector purpose, though narrower activation wording would reduce accidental invocation.
[T03] unexpected: The artifact contains the reported remote installer execution commands; this supports Review because the effective setup payload can change after review.
